sections.title: I. Moderato doloroso – The Solitary Lament (M. 1–28)
sections.character: Sotto voce solitary cantilena, weeping chromatic bass, and poignant Neapolitan sighs

sections.title: II. Più mosso appassionato – Nostalgia in Eb Major (M. 29–72)
sections.character: Liszt three-hand illusion: soaring tenor melody wrapped in rippling crystalline arpeggios

sections.title: III. Tempestoso e crescendo – The Gathering Storm (M. 73–104)
sections.character: Urgent syncopated chords over rising chromatic bass octaves, gathering uncontrollable fury

sections.title: IV. Cadenza precipitosa – The 7:35 Precipice & Cutoff (M. 105–112)
sections.character: Harrowing 4-octave chromatic descent slamming into an abrupt dead-stop cliff-edge silence

sections.title: V. Presto con fuoco – The Zimerman 7:40 Coda Drop-Off (M. 113–152)
sections.character: The Zimerman 7:40 drop-off: whispered sotto voce terror, sweeping 10th ostinatos, and 36-bar volcanic crescendo

sections.title: VI. Apoteosi Tragica & Final Stretta (M. 153–176)
sections.character: Blinding double chromatic scales, crashing full-keyboard octaves, and unyielding tragic minor resolution

annotations.title: The Weeping Lament Bass & Bel Canto Sighs
annotations.instruction: Allow the low G bell to ring with deep chest resonance. Let the right hand melody breathe with subtle rubato, leaning tenderly into the Neapolitan Ab Major harmony at bar 12.

annotations.title: The Liszt Three-Hand Illusion in Eb Major
annotations.instruction: Project the singing tenor melody with the fleshy pads of your alternating thumbs (velocity ~98). Keep the surrounding 12/8 treble arpeggios whispering like silk (velocity ~54).

pedalGuidance.explanation: Deep sympathetic bloom on downbeat bass roots with clean half-pedal clears on chord changes.

annotations.title: The 7:35 Cliff-Edge Cutoff & Dead Silence
annotations.instruction: Pour total body weight into the four-octave chromatic cascade. On the final downbeat of bar 112, kill the damper pedal INSTANTLY. The audience must feel the floor drop away into breathless silence.

annotations.title: The 7:40 Coda Drop-Off: Whispered Sotto Voce Terror
annotations.germanTerm: Presto con Fuoco: Sotto Voce Eröffnung
annotations.instruction: CRITICAL: Do not play loud here! Snap into 152 BPM in icy, whispered pianissimo. The left-hand ostinato leaps across tenths like an inescapable heartbeat of destiny. Let the crescendo build with terrifying patience over 36 measures.

pedalGuidance.explanation: Quarter-pedal syncopated taps on downbeats for electric crispness without muddying the ostinato.

annotations.title: Apoteosi Tragica: The Final Apocalypse
annotations.instruction: Unleash full orchestral power (fff). Engage back and shoulder muscles for the crashing double octaves. Hold the final low sub-contra G0 fundamental under full pedal until the acoustic vibration dissipates into eternity.
